audit.whatIsWrong: Level 2 row reads Akali on both layers while its own why-text describes Sylas hooking her out of Shroud and winning the trade; the packet level chart also reads Sylas for that row.
audit.why: E comes online at 2 and Twilight Shroud is a 20/19/18/17/16s cooldown — if she spent it, Sylas has a free hook window. The row contradicted its own explanation.
audit.corrected: Level 2 reads Sylas on both layers, rating raised to 6/10.

audit.why: Spikes are keyed to level 2 E, level 3 full kit, level 6 Hijack and Akali's two-item Shadowflame/Lich Bane flip — all four entries present and matched to the right timings.

audit.whatIsWrong: The early text calls Akali's Q 'Mark of the Assassin'. Riot's kit names her Q Five Point Strike. Separately, Assassin's Mark (P) — the empowered-auto reset that opens her burst — is never named.
audit.why: Mark of the Assassin is not an ability in her current kit; a wrong name breaks trust. The passive ring is the actual burst tell: the wind-up on the empowered auto is the cue to step back, not the ability cast.
audit.corrected: Q named Five Point Strike; Assassin's Mark named as the burst tell in whys[3]; Twilight Shroud's 16-20s cooldown stated as the commit window.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single matchup-defining cooldown, Twilight Shroud, is described but never numbered.
audit.why: 16-20s is a long, countable window and the whole commit rule hangs off it.
The packet flags wants.foe[0] 'Pop Twilight Shroud' as a suspect name. It is a false positive — Twilight Shroud is her real W.

edits.before: Akali approaches her level-6 spike and plays more aggressively; hold your E until she materialises out of Shroud or you waste both charges and she resets free.
edits.after: Akali approaches her level-6 spike; her burst opens with the Assassin's Mark empowered auto, so step back on that wind-up and hold E until she materialises out of Shroud.

edits.before: Untargetable inside — hold your CC and burst for when she exits. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: Untargetable inside — hold your chain and burst for when she exits. It is down 16-20s, and that gap is your commit.

edits.before: Level 1 you have Q and nothing else, so do not try to hook her — she has Mark of the Assassin poke and Twilight Shroud is already available to dodge your follow-up if she reads the aggression. Farm with Q range and track her Shroud cooldown. Level 2 the math shifts: the moment E is up and her Shroud is on cooldown, E1 dash in to absorb her counter-poke with the shield, then fire E2 to chain her, Q slow to confirm, and W lunge for the missing-HP burst. If she burned Shroud entering the wave, that is your window — take it every time. Level 3 consolidates the pattern: full kit with passive Petricite autos woven between Q and W means one full rotation costs her 40-50% HP while your W heals back most of her counter-damage. Never commit E2 while Shroud is available; she becomes untargetable mid-flight and you hand her a free trade.
edits.after: Level 1 you have Q and nothing else, so do not try to hook her — she has Five Point Strike poke and Twilight Shroud is already available to dodge your follow-up if she reads the aggression. Farm with Q range and count her Shroud's 20s cooldown. Level 2 the math shifts: the moment E is up and her Shroud is down, E1 dash in to absorb her counter-poke with the shield, then fire E2 to chain her, Q slow to confirm, and W lunge for the missing-HP burst. If she burned Shroud entering the wave, that is your window — take it every time. Level 3 consolidates the pattern: full kit with Petricite Burst autos woven between Q and W means one full rotation costs her a real chunk while your W heals back most of her counter-damage. Never commit E2 while Shroud is available; she becomes untargetable mid-flight and you hand her a free trade.
